description: Invention, innovation, and imagination have driven Brompton since founder Andrew Ritchie first engineered a folding bike to unlock the city. The original steel Brompton became a design icon, setting the standard for folding bikes for nearly fifty years.Continuing this tradition, the T Line Ceratech takes urban cycling to a new level, handcrafted in titanium for strength equal to steel but at half the weight. Now available with a durable tech-ceramic Cerakote finish—normally reserved for spaceships and racing cars—this bike combines precision engineering with striking, futuristic design, making city rides feel extraordinary.Every element of the T Line Ceratech is optimised for performance. Its TIG-welded titanium frame, superlight carbon crankset and saddle, Schwalbe One tyres, Tubolito tubes, and self-aligning hinge clamps provide a smooth, responsive ride. With a steel-armoured carbon seatpost, quick-release pedals, and low or mid carbon handlebars, it’s versatile, lightweight, and ready for any urban adventure.
